调用结果尚未确认，预算预留保留。请先核对模型厂商记录；不会自动重复调用。: The call outcome is uncertain and its budget reservation is retained. Check your provider records; the call will not be repeated automatically.
输出达到长度限制，候选文字可能不完整。请对照原件逐段核查。: The output limit was reached and the candidate may be incomplete. Check every passage against the original.
已有转录或即时分析任务正在运行，请先等待它完成。: A transcription or analysis is already running. Wait for it to finish.
请每次选择不超过 10 个有效页码。: Choose up to 10 valid pages at a time.
所选页码不在这份材料中。: A selected page is not in this source.
删除账号前，请退出并重新登录，然后在 15 分钟内确认。: Before deleting your account, sign out and sign in again, then confirm within 15 minutes.
请输入当前账号的完整邮箱。: Enter the full email address of your current account.
项目清单已改变，请重新查看后确认。: Your project list has changed. Review it again before confirming.
恢复记录不存在。: This restore could not be found.
已有恢复尚未完成，请继续或取消它。: A restore is already pending. Resume it or cancel it first.
项目记录过大。: The research records exceed the restore limit.
备份包含不支持的记录类型。: This backup contains records this version cannot restore.
单次恢复最多 50,000 条研究记录。: Restore up to 50,000 research records at a time.
单次恢复最多 500 份材料。: Restore up to 500 sources at a time.
备份混入了其他项目的记录。: This backup contains records from another project.
备份包含重复记录 ID。: The backup contains duplicate research records.
原件清单与研究记录不匹配。: The originals do not match the research records.
备份包含未登记的原件。: The backup includes originals missing from its source list.
备份包含循环引用。: The backup has circular references that cannot be restored.
备份字段与当前版本不兼容。: Some backup fields are incompatible with this version.
备份有指向包外或不一致的引用，无法完整恢复。: The backup has missing or inconsistent references and cannot be fully restored.
恢复后的记录和页码索引超过上限，请拆分项目。: The restored records and page index exceed the limit. Split this project first.
恢复计划过大，请联系支持。: This restore is too large. Please contact support.
无法开始恢复：请检查可用存储空间或已有恢复任务。: Could not start: check your available storage and any pending restore.
请选择开始恢复时使用的同一份备份。: Select the same backup used to start this restore.
恢复计划不存在，请取消后重新开始。: The restore plan is missing. Cancel this restore and start again.
恢复不在上传阶段。: This restore is no longer accepting uploads.
原件校验失败，未写入。: The original failed its integrity check and was not saved.
恢复状态已改变，请重新打开恢复窗口。: The restore status has changed. Reopen the restore window.
请先上传所有原件。: Upload all originals before restoring the records.
恢复计划尚未保存，请取消后重试。: The restore plan was not saved. Cancel and try again.
备份包含重复或无效的文件路径。: The backup contains duplicate or invalid file paths.
备份解压后超过允许大小（项目记录 8 MB、单份原件 20 MB）。: The extracted backup exceeds the limit: 8 MB of records or 20 MB per original.
备份文件数量与清单不匹配。: The backup file count does not match its manifest.
备份校验失败。请重新下载备份后重试。: Backup integrity checks failed. Download the backup again and retry.
备份不完整或超过 512 MB。: The backup is incomplete or exceeds 512 MB.
项目记录的校验值不匹配。: The research records failed their integrity check.
恢复已完成，不能作为未完成任务取消。: This restore is complete and cannot be cancelled as an unfinished copy.
恢复完成，请刷新项目列表。: Restore complete. Refresh the project list.
研究步骤已暂停、取消或执行轮次已改变。本次没有发起模型调用，预留预算已释放。: The research step was paused, cancelled, or replaced. No model call was made; the budget reservation was released.
此任务由旧版创建，需要重新确认。本次没有发起模型调用，预留预算已释放；请检查任务: This task was created by an older version and needs confirmation. No model call was made and the budget reservation was released. Review the task, then retry explicitly.
操作较频繁，请稍后重试。未提交的内容仍保留在当前页面。: Too many requests. Please wait and try again. Unsubmitted content remains on this page.
分页位置无效，请刷新重试。: Invalid page position. Please refresh and try again.
单条记录过大，无法在页面中加载。请联系支持。: This record is too large to load. Please contact support.
记录在读取时发生变化，请刷新重试。: The record changed while loading. Please refresh and try again.
服务器暂时无法响应，请稍后重试。: The server is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
审读引文不在当前前置结果中，请重新打开草稿并核对出处。: A review citation is not in the current upstream results. Reopen the draft and check its sources.
正文中有找不到出处的引文编号，请对照预览修改后保存。: A citation number in your text has no matching source. Check the preview and correct it before saving.
请由使用该模型账号的研究者管理批次。: Only the researcher using this model account can manage the batch.
请求编号已使用。: This request identifier is already in use.
资料已有新版本，请刷新。: A newer source version is available. Refresh to continue.
页码不属于该版本。: The page is not part of this source version.
请选择支持图像的模型。: Choose a model that supports images.
已有未完成的转录批次，请先继续或取消它。: Resume or cancel your unfinished transcription batch first.
临时图像空间不足，请减少页数或取消旧批次。: Not enough temporary image storage. Select fewer pages or cancel an older batch.
批次已开始或已取消。: The batch has already started or was cancelled.
页码不在批次内。: The page is not in this batch.
请提供不超过 2 MB 的 JPEG 页图像。: Provide a JPEG page image no larger than 2 MB.
页图像无效或过大。: The page image is invalid or too large.
批次状态已改变，请刷新。: The batch status changed. Refresh to continue.
请先完成图像上传或核对未确认页面；取消后新建批次可复用已完成候选。: Finish uploading images or inspect unresolved pages. Cancel and create a new batch to reuse completed candidates.
资料已更新，请在新版本上继续。: The source was updated. Continue with the new version.
此页已有调用记录，请核对后继续。: This page already has a recorded request. Inspect it before continuing.
模型或图像服务不可用。: The model or image service is unavailable.
页图像不可用，请重新准备。: The page image is unavailable. Prepare it again.
模型配置已改变，请核对模型与费用后重新创建批次。: The model configuration changed. Check the model and costs before creating another batch.
本批预算不足，后续页面未调用模型。请核对后新建较小批次。: The batch budget is insufficient; later pages were not sent to the model. Review usage and create a smaller batch.
此页已有调用记录，未重复调用。: A request already exists for this page; no duplicate was sent.
未发起调用；请核对后新建批次。: No model request was sent. Review and create a new batch.
执行中断，请核对已保存结果和用量。: Execution was interrupted. Check saved results and usage.
请明确说明本页是否完整、尚有多少记录及局限。: Specify completeness, remaining records and limitations for this page.
声称完整时，尚未摘录的记录必须为零。: A complete page must have zero remaining records.
请选择范围内两个不同的校准与核查页。: Choose two different calibration and validation pages within the selected scope.
该页原文已变化，请核查最新版本后重新转录。: This page text has changed. Review the latest version before transcribing again.
转录候选与所保存的页面版本不匹配。: The transcription candidate does not match this page and source.
结果未确认，请检查任务和厂商用量。: The result is unconfirmed. Check task records and provider usage.
准备未完成，未调用模型。: Preparation did not finish; no model request was sent.
结果未确认，不会自动重复付费。: The result is unconfirmed. No automatic paid retry will be made.
准备失败，请检查模型连接、图像及预算。: Preparation failed. Check the model connection, page image and budget.
直接搜索最多 3 行，每行 200 字；较长的问题请使用 AI 整理。: Direct search accepts up to 3 lines of 200 characters each. Use AI planning for longer questions.
新连接需要填写 API key。: Enter an API key for a new connection.
这次检索已开始或未完成。请查看历史记录；不会自动重复请求。: This search has already started or was interrupted. Check history; it will not be retried automatically.
这条书目不在已保存的检索结果中。: This reference is not in the saved search results.
尚未配置服务端密钥加密。: Server-side key encryption is not configured.
请先在「助手设置」中保存默认模型与费率，再运行 AI 资料搜索。: Save a default model and its rates in Assistant settings before using AI query planning.
搜索助手未返回可执行的检索词。请查看用量记录后再决定是否重试。: The assistant did not return usable queries. Check usage before deciding whether to retry.
搜索请求不属于当前项目。: This search request belongs to a different project.
这次搜索已经结束，请发起新的搜索。: This search has ended. Start a new search.
